units: UE cm; rotator degrees; same convention as geo_<District>.json
covered_rule: scene placements with a geo placement within 50 cm are left out
layout: per mesh at off: uint16 positions v*3 (lo..hi), pad to 4, uint16 uv v*2 (ulo..uhi), uint16 indices (uint32 if i32)
group: [start, count, #rrggbb, base texId or -1, normal texId or -1] (start/count in indices)
